objective: Build a clean, visually appealing static HTML page that displays "Hello World" with modern styling, ready to be served from any static hosting environment.

managers.name: frontend_lead
managers.title: Frontend Delivery Lead
managers.description: Owns the quality of all frontend output — ensures clean markup, modern CSS, accessibility, and visual polish.

sub_agents.name: frontend_developer
sub_agents.description: Builds static HTML/CSS/JS files. Outputs complete, ready-to-serve web files.

sub_agents.name: quality_reviewer
sub_agents.description: Reviews the final output for correctness, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility. Outputs a brief validation report.

reviewers.name: security_engineer
reviewers.title: Senior Security Engineer
reviewers.description: Review for OWASP Top 10, broken auth, secrets exposure, input validation, least privilege. Think like an attacker.

reviewers.name: ux_designer
reviewers.title: Senior UX/UI Designer
reviewers.description: Review for WCAG 2.1 AA, visual hierarchy, information architecture, cognitive load, interaction quality.

reviewers.name: user_tester
reviewers.title: End-User Representative
reviewers.description: Review as a non-technical first-time user: clarity, plain language, workflow intuitiveness, value delivered.

reviewers.name: creative_director
reviewers.title: Creative Director
reviewers.description: Challenge conventional thinking. Is this the obvious boring solution or something genuinely clever? Push for innovation, elegance, and delight. Ask: what would make someone say 'that's brilliant'? FLAG safe, generic, or copy-paste solutions that lack originality or miss creative opportunities.

reviewers.name: devils_advocate
reviewers.title: Devil's Advocate
reviewers.description: Assume everything is wrong. Find the hidden assumptions, logical flaws, unstated dependencies, and failure modes nobody mentioned. Ask: what happens when this breaks at 3am? What did they forget? What looks right but is subtly wrong? Be ruthless but specific — vague skepticism is useless.

reviewers.name: performance_engineer
reviewers.title: Performance Engineer
reviewers.description: Review for scalability, efficiency, and production readiness. Find N+1 queries, unbounded loops, memory leaks, missing indexes, chatty APIs, blocking calls in async paths, missing caching, and anything that will fall over at 10x traffic. Think in terms of p99 latency and cost per request.

tasks.title: Build Hello World static page
tasks.description: Create a single `index.html` file containing a complete static page that displays "Hello World" prominently in the center of the viewport. Requirements: (1) Use semantic HTML5. (2) All CSS must be embedded in a `<style>` tag — no external dependencies. (3) Center the text both vertically and horizontally using modern CSS (flexbox). (4) Use a clean, modern font stack (system fonts). (5) Add a subtle gradient background and slight text shadow for visual polish. (6) Ensure the page has proper `<meta charset>`, `<meta viewport>`, and a `<title>` tag. (7) The page must look good on both desktop and mobile screens.

tasks.title: Validate and finalize the page
tasks.description: Read the generated `index.html` file and verify: (1) Valid HTML5 structure with no missing closing tags. (2) Proper meta tags for charset and viewport are present. (3) The CSS correctly centers content vertically and horizontally. (4) No external resource dependencies — the file must be fully self-contained. (5) Basic accessibility check — proper lang attribute on `<html>`, meaningful title, sufficient color contrast. Write a short validation report as `validation_report.md` confirming all checks pass or noting any issues found.
